body:
DELIVERED + codex-verified. Commit c3c52411 (amended to soften a doc comment).
Added a TEST-ONLY composed-layer fault seam (ComposeFaultHook/ComposeFaultPoint) on ComposedBackend in
pqueue-engine, gated exactly like the existing pqueue_objectlog::FaultHook (field defaults to None; never
installed from any production path — only the conformance test installs it; inert when unset).
Two instants struck through the real Backend::write seam inside ProjectionWriterView::apply:
- DuringProjectionApply: fires after the durable log append returned Ok, BEFORE projection.apply_live.
- AfterApplyBeforeResponse: fires after apply_live returned Ok, BEFORE write() returns.
Tests: ac_txn_4_during_projection_apply_crash + ac_txn_4_after_apply_before_response_crash pass; the
objectlog crash-point matrix extended with both composed cuts. Each injects at the instant, DROPS+REOPENS
the backend, and asserts on the RECONSTRUCTED PROJECTION (not log counts): (pending,leased,complete,failed)
== (3,1,0,0) — 3 accepted items preserved, faulted Claim(a1)+Push(a4) replays EXACTLY ONCE — plus a real
claim/reclaim proving a1 is not handed out twice (0 duplicate active leases). Stale-epoch rejection is
genuinely tested: a second owner acquires a new epoch, a superseded-epoch commit is EpochFenced while a
current-epoch commit succeeds.
Codex adversarial review: cut-point instants SOUND, projected-state assertions SOUND, stale-epoch + pass-flip
SOUND (TP-003 row 209 requires injecting each crash point + meeting the invariants, NOT divergent outcomes
between adjacent instants; the eventual-apply log-replay projection recovers both instants to the same
exactly-once state, disclosed honestly). Only nit was a "zero overhead" doc phrase (the seam adds a
None-clone + 2 is_some checks/write) — softened in the amend.
Verify (independent re-run, 0 failed): cargo test -p pqueue-conformance ac_txn_4 -> 3 passed; cargo test -p
pqueue-conformance -p pqueue-engine -p pqueue-objectlog -> all ok; cargo test -p pqueue-server -> 0 failed.
AC-TXN-4 objectlog evidence row: PASS, no GAP.
summary: composed projection-apply cut points (during-apply + after-apply-before-response) proven on projected state; codex-verified; row pass
